Sunzi on wisdom

Sunzi (traditionally 5th century BCE) approaches wisdom within military strategy. It treats intelligence, adaptation, terrain, morale, and minimizing costly conflict as keys to successful command. Systematically, the teaching links strategy, conflict, leadership into a practical and theoretical whole. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets wisdom most directly—useful for searches such as “sunzi quotes on wisdom.”

How to use this page

Start with the shortest passage, then compare tone across sources. Return to the Sunzi thinker page for biography and to the wisdom theme for other voices on the same question.
